prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1342; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving on the main road in Baytown, heading toward the freeway access. Traffic was moving slowly because of the light ahead.
Q: Were you stopped at the time of impact?
A: Yes, I had come to a complete stop behind a white sedan at the intersection. I'd been stopped maybe five or six seconds when I felt the hit from behind.
Q: How fast would you estimate the vehicle behind you was traveling?
A: It didn't look like much, but the impact was hard enough to push me into the car in front. I'd guess it was moving at a normal speed, maybe twenty or thirty miles an hour.
Q: Did you notice any warning before the impact, such as brakes or a horn?
A: Not really. I looked in my mirror a second before and I didn't see the other car slowing down. Then there was a bang and my head snapped back.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: My left wrist was badly hurt. I put my hand out on the steering wheel and then on the dash when we hit. The doctor said it's fractured, and I'm wearing a splint and I have a follow-up appointment next week. My neck is sore too.
Q: Have you received any medical treatment so far?
A: I was taken to the emergency room by ambulance and they took X-rays. I've been seeing my regular doctor since then.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been careful to follow the doctor's instructions, and I want my car repaired as soon as possible because I rely on it for work.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
